prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: side impact at intersection. Injury: knee injury. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1332; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with injuries sustained in a motor vehicle collision on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was proceeding lawfully through a controlled intersection when your insured failed to yield the right of way and struck the driver's side of our client's vehicle. The impact was severe and was consistent with the police report and the photographs of the damage to both vehicles.

As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered a serious knee injury that required prompt medical evaluation, imaging, and ongoing orthopedic treatment. Our client has been unable to work at full capacity, has missed time from employment, and continues to experience pain, swelling, and limited mobility. Medical records and billing statements documenting these losses are enclosed.

The liability facts here are clear. Your insured was at fault, and there is no reasonable basis to dispute responsibility for the collision. We therefore demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all of our client's claims arising from this loss. This demand will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a substantive response within that period, we will file suit without further notice.
